tasks.description: Inventories the clause files of vendor agreements with their types and key terms. Use when asked for a clause inventory of vendor agreements.
tasks.intent: Inventory clauses per vendor with types, key terms and missing clause types.

tasks.description: Flags vendor agreement clauses that fall outside the limits of the review policy. Use when asked for a risk flag report on vendor agreements.
tasks.intent: Flag clauses outside the review policy limits with severities.

tasks.description: Builds a renewal and notice-deadline calendar from the term clauses of vendor agreements. Use when asked for a renewal and notice calendar for vendor agreements.
tasks.intent: Compute next term end and notice deadline per vendor agreement.
